_doc: FE-C batch 4 (W9-9 local favourites lens), waiting for the ja (i18n lane). lf.rule and lf.gap carry platform's wording exactly (lib/recognition.js LF_RULE and its gap sentence); the numbers in lf.gap come from the page data.

strings.lf.rule: Open places recommended only by local press, local writers or vetted creators — none by an official or tourism source, and every source typed in our registry.
